materialized view "app"."mv_totals" -- totals

Columns
# | Field | Type                  | Null | Key | Default | Extra | Comment
--+-------+-----------------------+------+-----+---------+-------+--------
1 | code  | character varying(20) | YES  | UNI | NULL    |       |
2 | total | numeric               | YES  |     | NULL    |       |

Indexes
Name              | Columns | Unique | Type  | Visible | Comment
------------------+---------+--------+-------+---------+--------
ix_mv_totals_code | code    | YES    | btree | YES     |

Options
Option        | Value
--------------+---------
access_method | heap
owner         | postgres
populated     | no
comment       | totals

Definition
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW "app"."mv_totals" AS
SELECT code,
    sum(total) AS total
   FROM app.items
  GROUP BY code
WITH NO DATA
